thought.text: Login succeeded — Keycloak returned an auth code to the oauth2 callback. Let me follow the full chain to confirm the app returns 200 with the logged-in session.

reasoning_content: Login succeeded — the 302 redirect with an auth code to `http://localhost:3000/oauth2/callback` proves Keycloak authenticated the user. Now let me follow the full redirect chain to confirm the app returns 200 with the logged-in session.

action.command:
cd /tmp
CALLBACK=$(curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' \
  "http://localhost:3000/oauth2/callback?state=Lr0Hm2qBfYZdP2nksolwd0ySG-KNhhgyZn7XGmPBhys%3A%2Fapp%2F&session_state=440f7bda-bf27-41af-8580-acf88eff7c98&iss=http%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A9090%2Frealms%2Flocal&code=bf977895-e230-4a3e-93c5-1ebb133312f4.440f7bda-bf27-41af-8580-acf88eff7c98.c64e6eb3-c47e-4f21-8ff4-0111d9f4335b")
echo "callback redirect: ${CALLBACK}"
echo "=== now GET app with session cookie ==="
curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o app.html -w 'GET /app/: %{http_code} (final: %{url_effective})\n' -L "$CALLBACK"
echo "=== title ==="; grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>' app.html | head -1
echo "=== has SPARK? ==="; grep -oc "SPARK" app.html
echo "=== authz cookie present? ==="; grep -oE 'authjs\.session-token|authjs\.session-token\.secure|code_verifier|authjs[^ ]*' cj.txt | head
